title: MapReduce: Simplified Data Processing on Large Clusters
author: Jeffrey Dean and Sanjay Ghemawat (OSDI 2004)
why: The original paper: the programming model, partitioning, combiners, re-execution on failure and backup tasks, with measurements.

title: Resilient Distributed Datasets: A Fault-Tolerant Abstraction for In-Memory Cluster Computing
author: Zaharia et al. (NSDI 2012)
why: The Spark paper: lineage-based recovery, narrow vs wide dependencies, and why in-memory reuse speeds up iterative jobs.

title: Questioning the Lambda Architecture
author: Jay Kreps (O'Reilly Radar, 2014)
why: The essay that proposed the kappa architecture: one stream processing codebase, reprocessing by replaying a retained log.

title: Designing Data-Intensive Applications (chapters on batch and stream processing)
author: Martin Kleppmann (O'Reilly)
why: The best single explanation of MapReduce joins, skew handling, dataflow engines and how batch and stream processing relate.
